contents.label: Elevated
contents.about: Every Elevated feature, including Fixed Fatigue and the original-game fixes, with the original 36 teams and 1994 rosters.

contents.label: Elevated: 2026 Season Edition
contents.about: Every Elevated feature, including Fixed Fatigue and the original-game fixes, plus all 138 FBS teams with 2026 rosters and conferences and a new season mode with conference title games and the playoff. 4 MB ROM, 32 KB save RAM.

contents.label: Fatigue fix and gameplay fixes
contents.about: Only the fatigue fix and fixes for the original game's bugs: the run slowdown, the 2-point conversion kickoff and pitches to fast backs. Original teams, 1994 rosters and title screen.

contents.label: Fatigue only
contents.about: Only the fatigue fix (or no fatigue). No other gameplay changes. Original teams, 1994 rosters and title screen.

fatigue.label: Fixed Fatigue
fatigue.about: Recommended. Every player tires from what he does on the field and recovers between plays.

fatigue.label: No Fatigue
fatigue.about: Energy never drops. Nothing else changes: the original game with 1994 rosters and no other gameplay changes.
